name: Shoulder Impingement Protocol (Moderate)
description: Evidence-based 4-phase program for shoulder impingement. From acute pain relief through progressive rotator cuff and scapular stabilizer strengthening to return to sport and daily activities.
pain_rule: Max. 3/10 pain during exercise. Light sensation of tightness is acceptable, sharp or radiating pain requires a break or modification.
evidence_base: JOSPT 2023: Shoulder Impingement Clinical Practice Guidelines
Systematic Review (2024): Exercise therapy for subacromial impingement syndrome
Consensus: Progressive rotator cuff and scapular strengthening for impingement
progression_criteria: Pain level acceptable (max. 3/10 during, resolves within 24h)
Active range of motion in pain-free range is increasing
Sets/repetitions completed in 2 consecutive training sessions
No increase in night pain or resting pain

phase_education.1:
**Phase 1: Acute / Pain Relief (Week 1-2)**

In this phase, the focus is on pain relief and maintaining mobility. Passive and assisted movements as well as gentle stretches form the foundation.

**Goal:** Reduce pain and maintain mobility.

**Strategy:**
- Pendulum exercises for pain-free mobilization
- Passive and active-assisted range of motion
- Posterior capsule stretching
- Isometric activation of the rotator cuff
- Thoracic spine mobilization for upright posture

**Scientific Basis:** Early, pain-adapted mobilization and isometric exercises promote healing and prevent stiffness (JOSPT 2023).
phase_education.2:
**Phase 2: Strengthening (Week 3-6)**

The acute pain is subsiding. Now we begin targeted strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers.

**Goal:** Restore active range of motion, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control.

**Strategy:**
- Isotonic rotator cuff strengthening
- Scapular stabilization exercises
- Closed kinetic chain exercises for joint stability
- Continued posterior capsule stretching

**Scientific Basis:** Progressive strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers is the gold standard for shoulder impingement (Systematic Review 2024).
phase_education.3:
**Phase 3: Advanced Strengthening (Week 7-10)**

Your strength is building up. Now we increase resistance and integrate functional movement patterns.

**Goal:** Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation.

**Strategy:**
- Heavy resistance training (70-80% 1RM)
- Eccentric emphasis for tendon load capacity
- PNF diagonals for functional movement patterns
- Overhead pressing when pain-free
- Plyometric introduction

**Scientific Basis:** Eccentrically emphasized strengthening and progressive overhead loading show the best results for return to full function.
phase_education.4:
**Phase 4: Return to Activity (Week 10-12+)**

You are almost there! In this phase, you return to sport- and work-specific activities and build a maintenance program.

**Goal:** Sport-/work-specific function, injury prevention, long-term maintenance.

**Strategy:**
- Sport-specific overhead drills
- Plyometric training
- Functional carrying and lifting
- Maintenance program for rotator cuff and scapula
- Daily stretching program

**Scientific Basis:** A long-term maintenance program (2x/week) significantly reduces recurrence risk.

exercises.name: Pendulum Exercises (Codman)
exercises.description: Upper body leaning forward, affected arm hanging relaxed. Swing the arm gently forward/back, sideways, and in circles through body movement. No active muscle pull — gravity mobilizes the joint.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Passive Flexion (Stick-Assisted)
exercises.description: Lying on your back, stick in both hands. The unaffected arm pushes the affected arm overhead into flexion. Only as far as is pain-free. Hold 5 seconds, slowly return.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Passive Abduction (Pulley / Assisted)
exercises.description: Lying on your back or seated. The unaffected hand guides the affected arm sideways upward. Alternatively via pulley system. Maintain pain-free range.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Active-Assisted External Rotation (Stick)
exercises.description: Lying on your back, elbow bent 90° at the body. Stick in both hands, unaffected hand pushes the affected arm into external rotation. Slow and controlled.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Cross-Body Adduction Stretch
exercises.description: Standing or seated. Pull the affected arm at shoulder height across the body, unaffected hand gently supports at the elbow. Hold 30 seconds. Stretches the posterior shoulder capsule.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
exercises.description: Side-lying on the affected shoulder. Arm 90° in front of the body, elbow bent 90°. Unaffected hand gently presses the forearm toward the floor (internal rotation). Hold 30 seconds.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Isometric External Rotation (Wall/Doorframe)
exercises.description: Standing next to a wall, elbow bent 90° at the body. Press the back of the hand against the wall (external rotation), without movement. Hold 10 seconds, relax.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Isometric Internal Rotation (Wall/Doorframe)
exercises.description: Standing in a doorframe, elbow bent 90°. Press the palm against the frame (internal rotation), without movement. Hold 10 seconds, relax.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Isometric Abduction (Wall)
exercises.description: Standing sideways to the wall, arm at the body. Press the back of the hand/forearm against the wall (abduction), without movement. Hold 10 seconds. Shoulder blade stabilized.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Scapular Retraction (Shoulder Blade Squeeze)
exercises.description: Sit or stand upright. Draw shoulder blades back and down — like a V pointing downward. Hold 10 seconds, slowly release. No shrugging the shoulders.
exercises.intensity: Light — focus on correct shoulder blade position
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation (Side-Lying)
exercises.description: Side-lying, knees bent 90°. Top arm slowly circles backward, opening the chest. Eyes follow the hand. Slowly return. The thoracic spine rotates, not the lumbar spine.
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction, maintain mobility, gentle activation

exercises.name: External Rotation Side-Lying (Isotonic)
exercises.description: Side-lying on the unaffected side, elbow at the body bent 90°. Slowly rotate dumbbell or arm upward and lower in a controlled manner. Shoulder blade remains stabilized.
exercises.intensity: Light dumbbell or gravity, progressively increase
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Internal Rotation with Resistance Band (Standing)
exercises.description: Elbow at the body, bent 90°. Resistance band fixed at hip height to the side, rotate forearm toward the belly against resistance. Slowly and controlled return.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Scaption (Empty Can to Full Can)
exercises.description: Standing, raise arm in the scapular plane (30° in front of the frontal plane) to shoulder height, thumb pointing up (Full Can). Lower in a controlled manner. Alternatively start with slightly rotated thumb (Empty Can) and progress to Full Can.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Prone Horizontal Abduction (T's)
exercises.description: Lying face down, arm hanging sideways at 90° abduction. Raise arm horizontally to body level, thumb pointing to the ceiling. Actively squeeze shoulder blade. Lower in a controlled manner.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Prone Extension
exercises.description: Lying face down, arm at the side of the body. Lift arm with thumb toward the ceiling backward and upward. Pull shoulder blade back and down. Lower in a controlled manner.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Scapular Retraction with Resistance Band
exercises.description: Resistance band around a stable object. Pull shoulder blades back and down, hold 3 seconds. Return in a controlled manner.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Prone Rows (Scapular Rowing)
exercises.description: Lying face down, arm hanging sideways. Lift elbow toward the ceiling, actively retract shoulder blade. Lower in a controlled manner.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Serratus Push-Up Plus
exercises.description: Standard push-up position (wall or incline bench for easier variant). At the top, additionally push shoulder blades forward (protraction). Return in a controlled manner.
exercises.intensity: Bodyweight — wall/incline bench/floor depending on level
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Lower Trapezius Y-Raises
exercises.description: Lying face down on an incline bench or flat. Lift arms in Y-position (approx. 135°) off the floor. Thumbs pointing to the ceiling. Actively pull shoulder blades down and back.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs (Controlled)
exercises.description: Standing, pull shoulders up in a controlled manner (elevation) and consciously lower (depression). Even tempo, focus on full movement control.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Wall Slides
exercises.description: Back against the wall, forearms on the wall. Slowly slide arms upward and back — maintain scapular contact with the wall. Controlled movement.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Weight Shifts (Wall/Table)
exercises.description: Hands on wall or table, alternately shift bodyweight to the affected and unaffected side. Train shoulder blade stability under load.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Quadruped — Arm Lifts & Weight Shifting
exercises.description: Quadruped position, hands under shoulders. Alternately lift one arm slightly off the floor and shift weight to the opposite side. Core stays stable, shoulder blade controlled.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Ball Stabilization on the Wall
exercises.description: Hand on a ball against the wall. Perform small circles and perturbations (disturbance impulses), keeping the ball on the wall. Dynamically stabilize the shoulder joint.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Posterior Capsule Stretch
exercises.description: Continue cross-body adduction stretch and sleeper stretch. Hold 30 seconds, 3 repetitions, 2-3x daily. Keep posterior capsule and shoulder supple.
exercises.phase_goal: Restore active mobility, begin strengthening, neuromuscular control

exercises.name: Progressive External Rotation (Side-Lying)
exercises.description: Side-lying, affected arm on top. Elbow at the body, bent 90°. Slowly rotate dumbbell upward, lower with emphasized slow (3-4 sec) eccentric phase. Shoulder blade remains stabilized.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Eccentric Scaption
exercises.description: Raise arm in the scapular plane to shoulder height (concentric), then lower with emphasized slow (3-4 sec) eccentric phase. Thumb pointing up. Progressively increase dumbbell.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: PNF Diagonals (D1 & D2)
exercises.description: D1 pattern: Arm from lower-outside to upper-inside (flexion/adduction/external rotation). D2 pattern: Arm from lower-inside to upper-outside (flexion/abduction/external rotation). With band or dumbbell, controlled and fluid.
exercises.intensity: Medium to heavy band or dumbbell
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Dumbbell/Kettlebell)
exercises.description: Standing or seated, press dumbbells or kettlebell from shoulder height overhead. Full extension, lower in a controlled manner. Core stable, no arching into the lower back. Only when pain-free.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Dynamic Scapular Exercises with Resistance
exercises.description: Rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers with increased resistance. Includes rowing, Y-raises, and external rotation with heavier band or dumbbells.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Prone I-Y-T-W Series
exercises.description: Lying face down. Sequentially lift arms in I-form (straight overhead), Y-form (diagonal), T-form (sideways), and W-form (elbows bent) off the floor. Light weights (0.5-2 kg). Thumbs pointing up. Actively squeeze shoulder blades together.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Banded Pull-Aparts
exercises.description: Standing, hold resistance band at chest height with extended arms. Pull band apart horizontally, bring shoulder blades together. Return in a controlled manner.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: High Rows (High Rowing with Band)
exercises.description: Resistance band fixed at upper chest height. Pull elbows back and up, actively squeeze shoulder blades together. Return in a controlled manner.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Scaption with External Rotation (Scapular Plane)
exercises.description: Raise arm in the scapular plane (30° in front of frontal plane) while simultaneously performing external rotation. Combines scaption with ER movement for functional integration. Dumbbell.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Plyometric Ball Throws (Wall)
exercises.description: Throw a light medicine ball two-handed or one-handed against a wall and catch. Starting at chest height, then progressively higher. Wall push-offs as alternative. Quick, powerful, controlled movement.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Proprioceptive Training (Unstable Surfaces)
exercises.description: Exercises on unstable surfaces (balance pad, Bosu): push-ups, quadruped, ball stabilization. Perturbation drills for reactive shoulder stability.
exercises.phase_goal: Full strength, overhead function, sport-/work-specific preparation

exercises.name: Sport-Specific Overhead Drills
exercises.description: Simulate sport-specific overhead movements (e.g., serve, throw, strike, swimming motion). Start with light resistance and progressively increase. Focus on correct mechanics and load management.
exercises.phase_goal: Sport-/work-specific function, injury prevention, long-term maintenance

exercises.name: Plyometric Training (Medicine Ball Throws)
exercises.description: Medicine ball (2-3 kg) thrown overhead or as chest pass against a wall. Variation: one-arm throws. Explosive movement with controlled catching. Full-body coordination.
exercises.phase_goal: Sport-/work-specific function, injury prevention, long-term maintenance

exercises.name: Functional Overhead Carry
exercises.description: Lift and carry objects overhead (functional carry, shelf simulation). Everyday-relevant load with progressive weight. Technique and shoulder stability take priority.
exercises.phase_goal: Sport-/work-specific function, injury prevention, long-term maintenance

exercises.name: Rotator Cuff & Scapula Maintenance
exercises.description: Combination of external rotation, rowing, and Y-raises as maintenance program. 3 exercises alternating with resistance band or dumbbells. Continue long-term 2x per week.
exercises.phase_goal: Sport-/work-specific function, injury prevention, long-term maintenance

exercises.name: Maintenance Stretching (Daily)
exercises.description: Daily stretching program: Posterior capsule stretch (cross-body), sleeper stretch, pectoralis stretch (minor & major), thoracic spine mobilization. Hold 30 seconds each, 3 repetitions.
exercises.phase_goal: Sport-/work-specific function, injury prevention, long-term maintenance
